Evan L (Partnerships): Quick sync: CatalystSI asked for a compact LangChain+gateway integration pack for their SI customers. They want a Marketplace-ready bundle + a one-hour workshop.

Maya S (Eng): Scope? LangChain adapter + retrieval sample (LlamaIndex) or also gateway routing policies?

Evan L (Partnerships): LangChain adapter, LlamaIndex example, and a short doc showing routing + fallback to hosted model. Workshop targeted for June 2.

Owen R (DevEx): I'll prepare a tiny demo repo and a GH Actions workflow that deploys the gateway and sample app. ETA PR by Tue.

Priya N (Product): Marketplace checklist: SKU, support tiers, private deployment notes, and a short verified perf blurb. I'll draft SKU options.

Zoe K (Marketing): Need one-page collateral and a 3-slide workshop deck. Can we get perf numbers by May 25?

Maya S (Eng): Perf matrix: redwood-7b + redwood-13b-q4, seq 512 & 1024, batch 1 & 4. PerfBot please queue under tag catalystsi-2412.

PerfBot: Perf job queued. Provide GCS path and prompt CSV.

Owen R (DevEx): Uploading prompts to gs://redwood-partners/catalystsi-2412 and opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-repo/catalystsi-demo/pull/2

Ivy G (Legal): Send dataflow diagram and partner wording. Use "Validated with CatalystSI" not "Certified" unless formal audit completed. Also confirm no customer logs are retained in hosted flow.

Evan L (Partnerships): Action items: Maya - perf + compat doc (due TOM). Owen - demo repo + prompts (done). Priya - SKU copy (due May 20). Zoe - workshop deck after perf (due May 27). Ivy - review legal after dataflow posted. Reconvene Fri 9am PT. Thanks!
